description: This file defines classes and objects related to shippable vertex partitions in Spark GraphX, including data structures for vertex attributes, routing, and methods for shipping vertex data across partitions.

classes.name: VertexAttributeBlock
classes.description: Stores vertex attributes to ship to an edge partition, providing an iterator over vertex ID-attribute pairs.

classes.name: ShippableVertexPartition
classes.description: Represents a map from vertex ID to vertex attribute with routing information for shipping data across partitions.

classes.name: ShippableVertexPartitionOps
classes.description: Provides operations to modify or create new instances of ShippableVertexPartition.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructs a ShippableVertexPartition from an iterator of vertices, with optional routing table, default value, and merge function.

methods.name: withRoutingTable
methods.description: Returns a new ShippableVertexPartition with the specified routing table.

methods.name: shipVertexAttributes
methods.description: Generates vertex attribute blocks for each edge partition based on routing info.

methods.name: shipVertexIds
methods.description: Generates arrays of vertex IDs for each edge partition.

methods.name: withIndex
methods.description: Creates a new ShippableVertexPartition with a different index mapping.

methods.name: withValues
methods.description: Creates a new ShippableVertexPartition with different vertex attribute values.

methods.name: withMask
methods.description: Creates a new ShippableVertexPartition with a different mask.
